{{Top|leg}}
'''Modular Surface Stations''' were an adaptable prefabricated outpost system manufactured by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Engineering]]. The system was a set of standardized, self-contained modular unit. Among the modular units that Loronar produced were the [[Corporate-class modular unit|''Corporate''-class modular unit]] and the [[MSS-C-342A]] set of pre-selected units.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
